page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is a general-purpose, high-frequency compute server instance built on x86_64 architecture and managed through the KVM hypervisor. Driven by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a base frequency of 3.1 GHz, this instance supplies 64 virtual central processing units (vCPUs) and 256 GB of system RAM. This configuration maintains a 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio, providing 4.0 GB of memory per core without local GPU hardware accelerators.

Storage capability for the ecs.hfg6.16xlarge relies entirely on network-attached storage infrastructure, as no local NVMe or SSD drives are bundled with the hardware. For connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps. It includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating public IP assignment via cloud networking services if direct internet ingress or egress is required.

Combining a high CPU base clock speed with dedicated core allocation and balanced memory provisioning, the ecs.hfg6.16xlarge offers predictable execution performance for multi-threaded applications. The high single-core frequency makes it suitable for compute-bound tasks that require steady clock speeds, while the 256 GB memory capacity supports moderate in-memory datasets. Primary recommended workloads include web application clusters, enterprise resource planning (ERP) application servers, continuous integration and build environments, and data processing tasks.
